lane: magnetic tilt local-wavenumber contact locator; TMI HGM + TMI VG only enter the candidate
emission: shared emit_decimated tile_px=3 then emit_prefix; exact catalogue pixels zeroed; no 200 m H33-style halo prune
continuous_artifact_policy: If like-for-like uniqueness blocks sparse dots, retain a newly generated continuous research GeoTIFF; never mark it submission-approved.
split: shared spatial.folds: four fixed quadrants, entire intersecting 8-connected components withheld
metric: shared gems57-pooled-hide-v2; pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 R=300m

registry_thresholds.lane_stop: Spearman vs any compared raster >0.90 OR like-for-like forward overlap vs a dot-field raster >0.70
registry_thresholds.literal_dense_overlap: Reported via shared uniqueness.two_phase_summary; not used as a claim that the candidate copied a sparse lane

promotion: Positive paired lower CI versus all comparable controls AND like-for-like uniqueness AND complete registry clearance AND a separately authorized selector with current cap/usage. This run will not invoke a selector.
